import numpy as np, collections

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    counts=collections.Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    marker=min((v for v in counts if v!=0), key=lambda v: counts[v])
    pts=[(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]==marker]
    r0=min(r for r,c in pts); c0=min(c for r,c in pts)
    shape=[(r-r0,c-c0) for r,c in pts]
    sh=max(r for r,c in shape)+1; sw=max(c for r,c in shape)+1
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r in range(h-sh+1):
        for c in range(w-sw+1):
            if all(grid[r+dr][c+dc]==0 for dr,dc in shape):
                for dr,dc in shape: out[r+dr][c+dc]=marker
    return out

demo_result=transform(a)
